capability: Portfolio-integrated coating candidate decision card v2 for 5 canonical DGEBA epoxy amine hardeners (IPDA, DDS, DETA, TETA, m-XDA). Integrates 5 portfolio predictors (Tg openpoly ML; dielectric mixed openpoly+RadonPy ML; refractive index mixed ML; density stacked RF+Van Krevelen physics; water contact angle openpoly ML) with per-predictor Tanimoto NN applicability domain. REAL END-TO-END FINDING: 1/5 candidates pass ALL 5 AD gates. Top-ranked = DDS (composite 0.0632), chemistry-consistent (aromatic sulfone → high Tg 146°C). 3 candidates HONESTLY gated as OUT-OF-DOMAIN. Crown-jewel portfolio integration demo — grants no batch-release, manufacturing-qualification, optimizer, or product-performance authority. Composite score is a PROTOTYPE.

fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.composite_scoring_formula: composite = sigmoid((Tg_C - 100) / 20) × sigmoid((theta_deg - 90) / 15) × density_ok × ad_reliability_multiplier. Prefers Tg > 100°C, θ > 90° (hydrophobic), density 1.0-1.5 g/cm³, all AD gates ≥ 0.30. Chemistry-motivated PROTOTYPE, not regulatory or engineering metric.
